text:
perf-alert-bot: ALERT: Nightly perf CI detected a p95 regression for small-batch workloads (+28% vs baseline). run=nightly-ci-2026-03-18. Job: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 :rotating_light:

ana: Seen. Pulling down traces and logs now. @jay can you start a bisect for the small-batch-128 benchmark?

jay: On it. Which exact workload/seed? small-batch-128 or small-batch-64?

ana: small-batch-128, seed=42. Repro instructions: `./scripts/run_bench --bench small-batch-128 --seed 42 --iterations 100`. Logs show long scheduler stalls.

tomas: FYI I merged a scheduler micro-optim PR yesterday (PR #2107) that touched queue alignment. I'll check local repros.

riley: I've kicked off an automated bisect: `./scripts/bisect.sh --range=main~40..main --bench small-batch-128` -> job b-9876. ETA ~12m. Link: https://ci.internal/bisect/b-9876 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: Note: vendor pushed a CUDA kernel patch in the infra image last night (cuda-llr v2.3). Could be orthogonal but flagging.

perf-alert-bot: Trace snippet (aggregated): ```runtime_sched_wait() +42ms per call (hot path)``` sampled on gpu-12 nodes.

jay: @tomas can you point to commits that touched sched queue? If it's just PR2107 I can stop the bisect early.

tomas: PR2107 is the most likely. I just reverted it locally and the p95 drops back to baseline on my repro. Uploading a quick revert patch to `regress-hotfix` branch.

ana: :thumbsup: If revert looks good can we push a canary to the nightly pool (tag=regress-hotfix) and re-run the nightly-runner? I'll trigger the checks after canary is live.

riley: Canary job started: https://ci.internal/jobs/b-9876/canary. Early results: 3/4 samples show p95 back to baseline. Continuing to run full suite.

devon: Filing a follow-up to add a temporary watchdog around the scheduler spin so we don't regress again while we harden: GH #3311.

jay: I'll stop the bisect if the canary holds. If the revert is clean we'll cherry-pick the fix to the release branch and roll the nightly forward.

ana: Action items: 1) @tomas revert PR2107 in nightly branch (in progress). 2) @devon add temporary guard (GH #3311). 3) @riley monitor bisect/canary until full run finishes. 4) @jay prep rollback/cherry-pick PR. I'll draft a short postmortem tomorrow AM. :coffee:

perf-alert-bot: ALERT CLEARED: p95 returned to baseline after canary at ts=5067896701. Closing signal — keep monitoring for recurrence. :white_check_mark:

jay: Thanks all. I'll post a follow-up when rollback PR is merged.

ana: Great work team, night team stand-in please watch for any reoccurrence in the next two runs. :eyes:
